directive.name: testing
directive.description: Validate test quality, safety, and coverage against codebase standards

context.principle: Never delete tests to make them pass - fix the code or update the test
Never weaken assertions - keep specific expectations
All tests follow AAA structure: Arrange, Act, Assert

process.rule: Write tests for all new functionality
Use correct mocking strategy by architecture layer
Verify no tests were deleted or weakened

check.reason: No skipped tests without linked issue
No todo tests without linked issue

check.item: AAA pattern followed in all tests

example.code: // WRONG: Weakened to make test pass expect(result).toBeTruthy(); // Was: expect(result).toBe(5)
example.explanation: Keep specific assertion, fix code if wrong
Clear AAA structure makes tests readable and maintainable

example.code: // WRONG: Skip without explanation it.skip('should handle edge case', () => { ... });

example.explanation: If skipping is necessary, link to tracking issue
